notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight token enters the battlefield, Securitron Squadron and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Securitron Squadron trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Knight.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
